newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria's Abacha to plan for next century.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria's Abacha to plan for next century.

text.p: Nigeria's military ruler General Sani Abacha said on Wednesday he was setting up a committee to produce an economic plan until the year 2010.

"Vision 2010 will be articulated by a carefully chosen group of eminent intellectuals .. who are totally non-political," Abacha told the opening session of an economic conference in the capital Abuja.
Abacha said the plan would take nine to 12 months to prepare, and results would be used as a basis for the 1998 budget.
The economy of Africa's most populous nation has been in the doldrums since political crisis erupted in 1993, with the annulment of elections by a previous military government.
Abacha's tight fiscal policy in 1994 and 1995 is credited with reducing inflation and stabilising the naira currency, but there are few signs of economic growth.
The military government, under fire from western countries for alleged human rights abuses and lack of democracy, has said it will hand over to civilians by October 1998.
"We intend to entrench the entire process of Vision 2010 before the transition to democratic rule," Abacha said.
